Accept/decline/ignore your friend request and everything is safe. And i personally don't see any importants here. Neither a real problem. I think you listening a couple good points which could be improved. As well as some niche interests hwere not so many people are aware of.

"must done better" definitly not. It's already a functional system without any issues. It might be a bit simple. This is more like an "could be improved" than "must done better".

> Well, VRChat has no control options for friend requests. There is nothing. Only ON/OFF toggle and that is it.

Hold the phone, I can turn friend requests off? I might give that a go.

details:
First, i made a lot requests here:

https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/better-friend-request-system

https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/friend-request-system-rework-needed-security

https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/friend-request-system-rework-needed

https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/friend-request-system-need-change-for-security

https://feedback.vrchat.com/bug-reports/p/friend-request-popup-in-menu-stays-on-forever-why

And nothing is getting better. 

Let me explain the problem. Send friend request is way too easy. You can search name on website or ingame. And click request.

This easy part is also security problem. New players (some are crashers or toxic) are sending requests to many players.

And for streamers ... yes that is also problem. Unwanted requests. Not good.

I am streamer and i have huge problem with it. First, i like to have some friends. But i need better control over requests. Because i am almost forced to use Icon option instead Show Names to protect other friends. Some of them are also getting unwanted requests. That is very bad with current Friends Request system.

Well, VRChat has no control options for friend requests. There is nothing. Only ON/OFF toggle and that is it. That is not even control about it. This feature exists probably since beginning of VRChat when it got friend request system.

Today it's not more adjusted to today, because VRChat is getting bigger, means we will see more childrens, toxic people and spoiled people. Friends+ system is way too powerful. The chain linking is very deep, makes it not safe.

Here i want ask VRChat developers add more options to control friend requests (was already explained in some posts but because they're away in long list, i just repeat it again for 2024).

- Disable website to send request. It's one of the most unsafe places because everyone can search everywhere, even as new player. Toxic people can easy spam requests on website.

- Minimum rank to send requests. Blue and white are often crashers or toxic people. It must blocked ingame and on website.

- Only able to send request when in the same world. This is best option. It means player must in the same channel/world where i am. This will give me option to find player and see who player is, make some talk to know about person. I really hate many requests outside world, it feels so unsafe. This option will also disable searching ingame or website.

- Minimum age account before able to send request. Here again toxic people will start already requests as new player. They will lost patience if they must wait for 1 month or longer, so it helps pretty well to reduce problem.

- Add cooldown period in sending requests. Spamming request must not done easy.

Remove popup after some minutes. I dislike how long it stays visible on the menu. Why stay on for 30 minutes long? Seriously this is clearly wrong setting... Who asked this?

No feedback. That is also requested in one of old posts. I always wait with requests. I want see them first when i meet them someday in world. Problem: who send me request? There is no icon visible at their nametag. Yeah, that is most annoying problem. My list is stupid long and i am not gonna check every name. But clean up means also others cannot send me again request because it will blocked. May good to block some people but also not good to block good people. There is no good control over the list. I know friend request is accepted if i send request to them who requested early to me. Good feature, but it will not help with the messed up long list...

Do it not only for normal people. Do it also for streamers. Please. It's a big problem today. VRChat is getting bigger, my list is too long, it cause even lag when i open the list (!!!!) and i cannot see good people between many unwanted requests. It's complete mess now, because there is no control about it. I am really very sad how VRChat developers ignore this important problem. Everyone want safe place in VRChat. The request system is not safe now. It can easy misused today some people use YOU to crash the channel. That is not what we all want.

Make friends is good, but it must done in better controlled and safe way. Do we all agreed with it?
title: Need better Friend Request system. Seriously.
